hook: THE COIN VANISHES. THEN IT RETURNS.
yt_title: Coin Appears From Nowhere: Easy Science Trick #Shorts
desc: Pour water into a bowl and a hidden coin appears, thanks to refraction. Light bends when it moves from water to air. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Try this safe trick at home! 🪙 Ask an adult to help. Follow for a fact every day. Comment A if you will try it or B if not

lines.text: This coin vanishes. Then pouring water brings it back.
Put a coin in an empty bowl, near the edge.
Step back until the bowl rim hides the coin.
Now pour water in slowly. The coin pops into view.
Light bends as it leaves the water. That bend is called refraction. Ask an adult and try it.

v.t: LIGHT BENDS. YOUR EYES ARE FOOLED.
